description: List the calendars in the user's connected Outlook mailboxes: name, id, whether it is the default, and whether the user can add events. Use it to find a named calendar before reading it with get_calendar_events(calendar_id=..., account=...).

account.description: Email address of one connected Outlook mailbox. Omit to use every connected mailbox.

name: list_outlook_calendars
title: List Outlook calendars
